topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: The boundary shifts, sharp lines cut through the familiar. Whispers of iron and wood rise where the scents of earth and leaf once mingled freely. The air, thick with anticipation, carries the scent of change, of barriers. My steps are wary, paws treading softly on ground now marked. The rhythm of this place alters, a tightness in the chest, a restlessness in the limbs. The future looms, uncertain, edged with the threat of confinement. The space that was once an open invitation to roam and hunt narrows, shadows closing in. Movements become quicker, eyes scanning for new paths, new edges to this shrinking world. The urgency to understand, to adapt or escape, pulses with each heartbeat.
